column6: Ten years after the turmoil in Verdite...
The great will that sought to destroy humankind
had left the world, yet strife among people
never ended...
In Rikistria, in the south of the continent,
lies a labyrinth called the Holy Land.
They say a king once called the Plunderer King,
driven out by his own people, hides inside it.
After the king's fall the nation weakened,
and among the discontented people
some began to call for his return.
Those who feared his return wanted proof of his death.
They hired many mercenary bands to search the Holy Land.
One band had a young man among its members.
He had lost his family to war,
and the band that took him in as a child and raised him
was a second family to him.
Deep in the Holy Land, the band
fell into a trap in the labyrinth.
Surrounded by monsters,
they tried to retreat in the chaos.
He barely escaped,
but his wounds
left him unconscious.
When he came to,
a whole year had passed.
He learned the band had been destroyed,
and the few survivors had left the town.
Later, in town, he heard a rumor
of a figure wandering the Holy Land,
perhaps a survivor of the band, perhaps a ghost.
To learn whether his old comrades still wandered there,
the young man resolved
to enter the Holy Land once more.
